text: Donetsk on the horizon. The dragon has gone quiet. I am short on words myself.
A woman from Donetsk wrote to me. She’s moved three times over the years. She still carries her house key in her pocket.
People here have waited a long time to go home without checkpoints. We are doing this for them.
All three aircraft types up there?
Yes. A longer wave, too. Pace yourself. Do not get boxed in by missiles. We need you back.
